generator_rejection: No rejection sampler. Five mathematical role cases are chosen before k. Batch deduplicates prompt mathematics, then samples without replacement. Invalid k, shift and difficulty raise ValueError.
limits: Fixed-bank proof applies to controlled authored role groups: at fixed k for nonzero linear shifts, and at fixed k-window for cancellation targets. Source replay members are excluded from authored groups. It proves absence of bank-only predictors for these cases, not universal mastery or absence of all possible prompt-based shortcuts. Learner history/reservations/live policy selection are unavailable.
